subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Effectively** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Effectively **means in a way that achieves the intended result or purpose. (इस तरह से कि इच्छित परिणाम या उद्देश्य प्राप्त हो सके) • The word is an adverb and is commonly used to describe how something is done. • In the given context, the blank requires a word that denotes doing something in a successful or efficient manner. • **Example**: *The company implemented the new system effectively, resulting in a significant increase in productivity.* Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Economically **means in a way that relates to economics or financial matters. (एक तरह से जो अर्थशास्त्र या वित्तीय मामलों से संबंधित है) • **Sufficiently **means in a way that is enough or adequate for a particular purpose. (एक तरह से जो किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के लिए पर्याप्त हो) • **Vibrantly **means in a way that is lively, energetic, or brightly coloured. (एक तरह से जो जीवंत, ऊर्जावान या चमकीले रंग का हो) 49:Tb26, The correct answer is: **Mistakes**
